title: Blur-gate scope excludes router_basic/router_high; basic tier sits ~7° from the host family
evidence:
SPAWNS = [
    ("router_mid", 20, 15),
...
  "small_biz_family":   [110, 155, 116, 184],
  "campus_family":      [168, 114, 80, 184],
  "residential_family": [205, 92, 92, 204],
  "host_family":        [70, 130, 180, 184],
  "router_tier_basic":  [124, 136, 152, 102],
...
	anchors := [5]rl.Color{
		p.small_biz_family, p.campus_family, p.residential_family,
		p.host_family, p.router_tier_mid,
	}
...
| all 10 pairs | 4 pairs < 15° | **min 22.6° — all ≥ 15°** ✅ |
detail: Spec acceptance: "all node-type pairs hue-separated ≥15°". The gate samples only router_mid; router_tier_basic (≈214°) is ≈7° from host_family (≈207°) and both the gate and the token test exclude basic/high — the claim's scope is narrower than the criterion.
recommended_fix: Add a basic/high router plus a host to a gate capture (or extend the token test anchors) and document basic's ring-only separation if intentional.

title: D7's "clean merge in either order" is false — this PR and PR #77 both replace the same palette.json _comment line
evidence:
@@ -1,5 +1,5 @@
 {
-  "_comment": "Palette catalog (look-book v1, ... cat.hash is golden-poison).",
+  "_comment": "... cat.hash is golden-poison). v2-node-clarity (2026-08-22): the terminal-class hue families + router tier markers (Q2a/Q2b) — ADDITIONS ONLY, ...",
--- gh pr diff 77, data/palette.json @@ -1,5 +1,5 @@:
-  "_comment": "Palette catalog (look-book v1, ... cat.hash is golden-poison).",
+  "_comment": "... cat.hash is golden-poison). v2-network-pop (2026-08-22, user ruling: networking must pop): ..."
detail: Tokens are additions-only and no token keys collide with #77 (verified: #77 edits router_led/pipe_*/packet_*/lane_* values only). But both PRs replace the identical base _comment line with different text — a guaranteed textual conflict either merge order.
recommended_fix: Rebase whichever lands second and concatenate the two _comment tails; both appendages are compatible.

title: palcheck LED pin bakes the pre-POP router_led composite; #77's LED change will break it at wave merge
evidence:
LED_GREEN := rl.Color{77, 137, 113, 255}   // the basic puck's LED washed with steel (0.40)
--- gh pr diff 77, data/palette.json:
-  "router_led":    [46, 139, 87, 255],
+  "router_led":    [0, 205, 90, 255],
detail: 77,137,113 is exactly the old LED {46,139,87} washed at 0.40. #77 changes router_led to [0,205,90], so this pin (and the washed-LED pixels) fail until the documented final-wave reconciliation re-pins them.
recommended_fix: Add the washed-LED/hardware pins to the wave-reconciliation checklist for explicit re-measurement after #77 merges.

title: Spec said "reuse" existing tray icons; none exist and the PR-body claim overstates the resemblance
detail: Briefing item 2: "the tray icons already exist — reuse them". The tray chips are rect + text labels (draw_text), not per-role glyphs; draw_type_chip invents a new glyph set. Deviation is documented but the 'same rect+glyph recipe' claim overstates it.
recommended_fix: Correct the PR-body wording, or extract a shared chip+glyph proc if the tray later adopts silhouette glyphs.
